notes.0-4: "The rookie's pitch impressed the owners" (or "pitched it to the scouts") can be read as his throw or his sales talk; the selling sense extends the throwing one.
notes.2-4: "She softened her pitch for the older clients" is defensible as her tone of voice or her sales talk.

notes.0-4: "They scrambled up the bank by the canal" can mean the riverside or a heaped-up ridge of earth (an embankment).
notes.2-4: "The engineers banked the curve" can mean they tilted the roadway or built up (heaped) earth on its outer edge.
